dossier.summary: Larkspur Software makes scheduling software for independent veterinary clinics. It has about 35 people and sells through a small inside sales team and a partner program with clinic consultants.
dossier.why_now: Hired a head of marketing in September 2026 and started a monthly webinar series.

data.title: Turning Larkspur's monthly webinar into booked calls
data.intro: You started a monthly webinar the same month you took the marketing role, so the follow-up process is probably still being decided. Here is what I would set up in the first month and what I would skip.

reasons.heading: A new webinar series, one month old
reasons.body: The first few sessions decide what the follow-up looks like for the rest of the year. It is easier to set up the recording, the replay page and the handoff to sales now than to retrofit them.

reasons.heading: A small inside sales team
reasons.body: With a handful of reps, every attendee list has to be sorted before it is useful. I would want the webinar to tell your reps who to call first, not hand them a spreadsheet.

reasons.heading: Partners who sell for you
reasons.body: Clinic consultants in your partner program could host or co-host a session. A co-hosted session can work without adding work for them, and I would show you how.
